test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Electrons have much smaller mass than protons and neutrons.
The size of the nucleus is large as compared to the size of the atom.
The electrons revolve around the nucleus in triangular paths.
The electrons do not revolve around the nucleus in circular paths.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Electrons have much smaller mass than protons and neutrons.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electrons have much smaller mass than protons and neutrons:** The mass of an electron is approximately **9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg**, while the mass of a proton or neutron is about **1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg**. This means electrons are nearly **2000 times lighter** than protons and neutrons. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• **The size of the nucleus is large as compared to the size of the atom:** This statement is incorrect. The nucleus is extremely small compared to the atom. The radius of the nucleus is about **10⁻¹⁵ meters**, while the atomic radius is around **10⁻¹⁰ meters**. Thus, the atom is much larger than the nucleus.
